details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: _inject_token_into_url (lines 3040-3052) and _resolve_origin_url (lines 3055-3085) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GitHub authentication changed from per-command `http.extraHeader` injection to embedding cleartext tokens in HTTPS clone URLs.
  WHY: Tokens become visible in process arguments, Git diagnostics, and temporary `.git/config`; the removed header path also breaks GH_PAT-only environments.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: _memory_force_tick_remote_url at lines 541-594; memory Git operations at lines 137-190 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Memory Git authentication was replaced with token-bearing URLs and unauthenticated bare Git commands.
  WHY: Credentials leak through Git arguments and temporary remotes, while `persist-credentials: false` workflows cannot persist ai-memory records.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: deleted `model_provider_broker_*` family formerly at lines 143-475 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The model-provider broker helpers were deleted while production callers remain.
  WHY: Brokered phases fail with command-not-found under `set -e`, and the credential-isolation boundary is removed.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: lines 48-53 and 661-667 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Diagnose now invokes Codex directly with `--sandbox danger-full-access` and the real `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` instead of brokered read-only execution.
  WHY: Issue-derived diagnostic content reaches a model with full workspace write access and bypasses the provider credential boundary.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: deleted `is_sensitive_target_path`; normalize_path at lines 240-247; emit_context at lines 536-716 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path rejection and path validation were removed, and `emit_context` reads raw caller-supplied paths.
  WHY: Paths such as `.git/config`, `.env.production`, `.netrc`, and `.ssh/id_rsa` can be read into model prompts.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: emit_context at lines 562-564 / 543-545 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `max_bytes <= 0` now emits headers and a disabled marker instead of returning an empty string.
  WHY: The existing disable-switch contract and tests require `""`, so callers receive unexpected prompt content.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: emit_context at lines 568-579 / 650-660 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Missing-file and overflow markers do not consume the byte budget, and the path-count cap was removed.
  WHY: Unbounded missing or oversized path lists can exceed `max_bytes` and inflate model prompts.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: deleted `MAX_TARGET_PATHS`, `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES`, and `is_sensitive_target_path` | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Public module-level identifiers used by tests and callers were removed.
  WHY: `pytest` collection raises `ImportError`, breaking the targeted-context contract tests.

- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: lines 95-113 and 258-261 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` was removed from argument parsing and the generated `base_url` is hardcoded to `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`.
  WHY: Existing callers fail on an unknown argument, and the hardcoded endpoint bypasses the broker loopback URL.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: `_gh_pr_with_all_comments_rest` lines 766-772 and GraphQL projection lines 833-924 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Comment projections no longer include `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, or `author_association`.
  WHY: Review-thread correlation and review-blocked producer or maintainer authentication cannot function.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: deleted `git_with_github_auth` after line 493 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git_with_github_auth` was deleted while `review_rb_judge.sh` still calls it.
  WHY: Review-blocked fix and baseline pushes fail with command-not-found or unauthenticated Git.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: deleted `review_blocked_*` family formerly at lines 947-1374 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Review-blocked terminal-decision helpers were deleted while callers remain.
  WHY: Approval requests, decision digests, consumed markers, and successor issues cannot be processed, leaving terminal review-blocked flows pending.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: `_signal_child_group` lines 404-407; `_kill_child_group_if_running` lines 439-448; SIGKILL escalation lines 560-563 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Privileged signalling and SIGKILL escalation are skipped when the tracked sudo wrapper has exited even though isolated descendants remain.
  WHY: Surviving nobody-owned editor processes are detected but not killed, leaving the original signal gap open.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: `_forward_signal` lines 451-458 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Forwarded signals return without survivor verification or privileged signalling when the wrapper has exited.
  WHY: An external signal can produce neither a group kill nor an immediate survivor check.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: lines 484-491 and 561-583 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: A signal failure breaks the guard loop before the tracked child is reaped.
  WHY: The caller receives failure while the editor or wrapper can remain alive, allowing cleanup to race with a surviving process.

- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh: `terminate_editor_attempt_process_group` lines 292-336; watchdog lines 2178 and 2200 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Missing metadata or signalling helpers cause the watchdog to kill only the runner-owned guard, while `|| true` suppresses the failure.
  WHY: The nobody-owned editor group can survive while cleanup proceeds and ownership is restored.

- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh: line 2062 and editor_isolation_exit_trap at line 338 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The script still calls deleted `model_provider_broker_start` and unconditionally calls deleted broker stop functionality.
  WHY: The review-autofix path fails before model launch, and already-started broker processes can leak.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: `_isolated_user_from_command` lines 184-200; metadata publication lines 267-298 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Privileged signalling and metadata publication are selected from the `sudo -n -u <user>` argv shape without an explicit isolation opt-in.
  WHY: Non-editor callers using the same command shape can unexpectedly enter privileged signalling and survivor-verification semantics.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 62-68 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The artifact check switched from HEAD membership to index membership, removed `--staged`, and removed cached-entry cleanup.
  WHY: Detached, sparse, or staged worktrees can delete the artifact, leave it staged, or commit generated content incorrectly.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: lines 144-148 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `patch_diagnose_reasoning_into_config` is called unconditionally before broker setup and its failure is downgraded to a warning.
  WHY: Without broker-provided `CODEX_HOME`, configuration can be written to the runner's home and the intended reasoning settings may not apply.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Give the stall guard a privileged kill path when the editor is isolated: when the launched command starts with sudo -n -u <user>, signal the group via sudo -n kill -<SIG> -- -<pgid> (or sudo -n -u <user> kill ... for the nobody-owned members) instead of a bare os.killpg, and treat PermissionError as a hard, logged failure rather than letting it propagate silently. Keep the existing behaviour for non-isolated callers."
  expected_change_site: scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh `_signal_child_group` / `_kill_child_group_if_running`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  EVIDENCE: `_kill_child_group_if_running` and `_signal_child_group` return when the wrapper exits without signalling surviving isolated members.

- requirement: "Make the review_apply_fixes.sh watchdog kill the editor's process group the same privileged way (and only then the guard), so a wall-time or idle kill actually stops opencode before cleanup_editor_isolation chowns the workspace back."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh `terminate_editor_attempt_process_group`
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  EVIDENCE: Missing metadata or signalling helpers fall back to killing only the runner-owned guard, and watchdog call sites suppress the failure with `|| true`.

- requirement: "After every kill path, verify no nobody-owned process from the editor's group is still alive (pgrep -u nobody -g <pgid>) and log it if so."
  expected_change_site: scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh `_forward_signal` and kill paths
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  EVIDENCE: `_forward_signal` can return without verification; early-return kill paths skip the signal or verification, and cleanup verification occurs only later.

- requirement: "This must not weaken the isolation contract: the privileged kill is the only new sudo use, limited to signalling the editor's own process group."
  expected_change_site: scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh, scripts/editor_isolation_preflight.sh, scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  EVIDENCE: The PR also deletes the model-provider broker, Git authentication helpers, review-blocked helpers, and targeted-context secret filters, and grants diagnose full-access Codex.
